Fix: per link the step it was last crossed (last_detect, written in approach by the latest entrant of the junction lane); a head standing at its line (first on its lane, within 10 m) counts the gap from the later of that crossing and its stop, no further back than that foe can hold it (its time over the link plus timegap_minor); a gap taken from the line holds while the car moves (F_GAP_TAKEN), foes that cannot stop still block.
